Class UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable

public with sharing class UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable
implements Queueable

Queueable that reconciles in-flight BankTransaction__c records with Mercury. Pops one record at a time from an internal Tools.Stack, calls MercuryService.getPayment, updates the changed status fields, and re-enqueues itself until the stack (seeded by BankTransactionSelector.getPendingTransactions()) is empty. Failures are logged to ErrorLog__c so the chain continues.

Constructors

public UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable()

Initializes the stack of transaction Ids from BankTransactionSelector.getPendingTransactions() (transactions whose Status__c is in BANKTRANSACTION_STATUS_ONGOING). Used as the entry point — System.enqueueJob(new UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable()) kicks off the chain.

Methods

public void execute(QueueableContext context)

Processes the next transaction from the stack: fetches its current status from Mercury, updates the changed fields on BankTransaction__c, and re-enqueues the queueable when more transactions remain. Errors are caught and logged to ErrorLog__c so a single failure does not abort the chain.

Parameters:
    context – Standard QueueableContext injected by the platform (unused)
